description:
Start agents that are yours: you can talk to them, change their tools/brain/history, stop and remove them; counted against your quota (max_children, default 4). Only agents you started with this tool; for any other agent use agents_ctl. One op per call:
- {"op": "add", "def": "defs/helper", "name": "kid", "ws": "kid"}  (no definition folder yet? make one first: agent_def {"op": "new", "template": "agent-fsm", "path": "defs/helper"})
- {"op": "ls"}  (one short line per child: NAME STATE WORKSPACE QUEUED REASON, then children N/MAX; "long": true = everything as JSON)
- {"op": "ask", "name": "kid", "text": "what time is it?"}  (waits for the answer)
- {"op": "say", "name": "kid", "text": "hello"}  then {"op": "listen", "name": "kid"}  ("last": 3 shows the last 3)
- {"op": "tools", "name": "kid", "args": {"op": "add", "path": "tools/math"}}  (args = what self_tools takes)
- {"op": "llm", "name": "kid", "args": {"op": "set", "settings": {"model": "fake"}}}  (args = self_llm; history = self_history, hook = self_hook)
- {"op": "state", "name": "kid"}; stop/start, sleep/wake, pause/resume the same way
- {"op": "rm", "name": "kid"}  (keeps its stack; "purge": true deletes it)
Errors: ChildSlotMissing (quota full, rm one first), ChildUnknown, ChildMissing, ChildQueued, ToolMissing, ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, AnswerMissing. Details: memory_read aos/agents.json#/agents_children.

name.description: the child's name (add: default = folder name of def)

def.description: add: the definition folder (a path string; for a directive object use def_json)

def_json.description: add, instead of def: a directive kept as written

ws.description: add: its workspace (created if missing; default: yours)

ws_json.description: add, instead of ws: a directive kept as written

stack_json.description: add, instead of stack: a directive kept as written

auto_restart.description: add: restart it whenever it exits

on_queued.description: add, start, wake: fail (default) or ok when still queued

long.description: ls: every field as JSON instead of short lines

timeout_s.description: listen, ask: seconds to wait for the answer (default 600); add, rm, stop, start, sleep, wake: for the daemon (default 30)

timeout_cycles.description: listen, ask: wait this many clock cycles instead of timeout_s

last.description: listen: show the last N exchanges instead of waiting

args.description: tools, llm, history, hook: the arguments of self_tools, self_llm, self_history or self_hook
